sources: https://github.com/Kotak-Neo/Kotak-neo-api-v2 (official SDK; neo_api_client/settings.py PROD_URL, rest.py jData encoding)
notes: Order/trade/positions/holdings/limits/place/modify/cancel payloads copy the field names of the SDK docs' samples (IDEA cash examples) re-pointed at dummy NIFTY October 2026 contracts. The positions sample in Positions.md lacks the cfBuyQty/flBuyQty/... fields its own 'Positions Calculations' section uses, so those documented fields are added. Kotak publishes no quotes response sample: the quote rows use the field names this repo's earlier reviewed module and OpenAlgo read (exchange, exchange_token, ltp, last_volume, open_int, ohlc, depth). Session fields are added per fixture so manifest.creds stays logged out. Every token, id and name is a dummy.
